text:
Maya Thompson: Heads-up — Pulse Summit next Friday. ScaleBridge and Redwood are co-hosting a 25-min mini-lab (marketplace flow + live appliance demo). Need final speaker order, demo rollback policy, swag staging, and marketplace publish timing.

Ethan Cole: I can own demo routing & failover. Primary: ScaleBridge appliance in booth (private). Fallback: Redwood Dedicated (us-east-1). Last resort: hosted API. Canary plan 70/30 to start. Failover triggers: p95 > 550ms for 40s OR 5xx > 0.7% sustained.

Ravi Gupta: I'll do infra handover and observability. Plan: pre-warm KV cache during dry-run, push traces to shared OTLP, Grafana dashboard link will be in Drive. I'll add a small SLO: error_rate < 0.6% during demo.

Lydia Park: Speaker flow draft: 11:00 intro (Maya) 3m, 11:03 ScaleBridge marketplace walkthrough 8m, 11:11 Redwood infra + live inference 10m, 11:21 Q&A + raffle 4m, 11:25 wrap. Need final slides + bios by Wed EOD. Marketing needs screenshot for listing by Thu noon.

Maya Thompson: Swag plan — 150 sticker packs, 60 insulated bottles, 40 lanyards, 10 limited lab vouchers for raffle. Pack manifest in Drive: `PULSE-SWAG-MANIFEST.xlsx`. Can we print a small tabletop A-frame that says "Redwood x ScaleBridge"?

Ethan Cole: AV checklist: HDMI adapters (USB-C, miniDP), 2x spare ethernet, a small PoE switch, one HDMI capture device for stream, and a battery pack. Onsite volunteer: Omar (ScaleBridge) confirmed, +1-555-0199.

Ravi Gupta: Quick preflight healthcheck for ScaleBridge appliance (run from staging): `curl -s http://10.20.30.5:8080/health | jq -r .status` expected "ok". Also run a KV warm loop: `for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -X POST http://10.20.30.5:8080/cache -d '{"prefix":"demo"}' & done`

Ethan Cole: Canary routing snippet for console: `route: { primary: scalebridge-booth, fallback: dedicated-us-east, canary: 0.7 }`. Test script for load smoke:

```
# simple ramp test
for i in {1..150}; do curl -s -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "X-RW-Route: scalebridge" -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' &
done
wait
```

Maya Thompson: Shipping update: courier GateRun AWB GR112233. ETA Tue 17:00 to venue loading dock A. Manifest uploaded: https://drive.example/pulse/manifest_gr112233.pdf. Courier says customs needs ECCN + commercial invoice.

courier-bot: GateRun update: AWB GR112233 scheduled delivery Tue 17:05. Customs hold cleared pending vendor EIN; vendor EIN received this morning.

Lydia Park: Marketplace timing: ScaleBridge wants the listing live at 13:00 local day-of and a short joint post T+20m. Marketing needs 1 screenshot + 3 copy variants by Thu noon. Legal signoff required by Thu 10:00.

Ravi Gupta: Observability hooks: I'll create a Grafana panel with p50/p95/p99 and error rate. Webhook will post to #partnerships-alerts if SLO breaches. If breach happens, automation will flip to fallback route and post a manual announcement on stream.

Ethan Cole: Failover automation (pseudo):

```
if monitor.p95 > 550 for 40s or error_rate > 0.7 then
  call_console_api("switch_route", {route: "dedicated-us-east"})
  post_slack("Failover engaged: switching to dedicated-us-east")
fi
```

Maya Thompson: Backup plan — prep a 90s pre-recorded demo clip on S3 + a local USB stick. If live demo latency >40s or >1% errors, switch to clip and notify studio. Lydia will call it out on stage.

Ethan Cole: I'll pin model version `rw-scalebridge-q4k-v1` for the demo window and set `auto_update=false`. Also will run perf bench Tue night: `./bench --model rw-scalebridge-q4k-v1 --seq 512 --bs 4`.

Lydia Park: Raffle & lead capture — we'll use a QR that hits a short form. Need PRIZES list in Drive and printed QR card for the tabletop. Also request a form that captures consent for follow-up and recording.

Maya Thompson: Rehearsal scheduled Wed 18:00 PT — rehearsal-bot sent invites. Please be present. Action items: @Ethan run failover tests + pin model by Tue EOD; @Ravi create Grafana panel + test webhook by Wed EOD; @Lydia finalize slides, screenshots, and QR by Thu 10:00; @Maya confirm GateRun delivery Tue AM. Reply with :white_check_mark: when done.

Ethan Cole: :white_check_mark: will run tests Tue night and pin model.

Ravi Gupta: :white_check_mark: Grafana panel created; will test webhooks Wed morning.

Lydia Park: :white_check_mark: slides + QR uploaded to Drive.

courier-bot: Delivery update: AWB GR112233 delivered Tue 17:09 to Loading Dock A.

Maya Thompson: Thanks team — see you at rehearsal.
